content: I am writing to express my views concerning...
translation: 我写这封信是想表达关于……的看法。

content: I would like to extend my sincere suggestions on...
translation: 我想就……提出我真诚的建议。

content: I am writing to invite you to join us in...
translation: 我写信是想邀请你加入我们……

content: I am writing to see if you can do me a favor.
translation: 我写信是想看看你是否能帮我个忙。

content: I am writing to offer my sincere apology for...
translation: 我写信是想就……表达我诚挚的道歉。

content: To begin with / Furthermore / Last but not least
translation: 首先 / 此外 / 最后但同样重要。
相反 / 然而 / 或者。
因此 / 结果 / 所以。

content: Only in this way can we achieve our goals.
translation: 只有这样我们才能实现目标。（倒装句）

content: It is widely acknowledged that... is of great significance.
translation: 众所周知……具有重大意义。

content: Looking forward to your prompt reply.
I would appreciate it if you could take my suggestions into account.
translation: 如果你能考虑我的建议，我将不胜感激。
